title: land T-0554 on goal/T-0551: cherry-pick the Deskmere bundle-id commits the T-0560 merge never carried
spec:
Why: goal/T-0551 lacks the Deskmere bundle identifiers. T-0554's two commits live only on task/T-0554: 8464b1b "T-0554 update Deskmere Apple identifiers" (16 files: apple/project.yml, Info.plist, entitlements, WidgetSnapshot.swift, push fixtures, NotificationTests.swift, new BundleConfigurationTests.swift, docs/release/staging-setup.md, docs/release/testflight.md) and 6ea3ee3 "T-0554 isolate schedule sweep pgTAP test from cron" (supabase/tests/17_m9_schedules.sql). The re-gate fix round T-0560 merged an empty branch, so neither reached the goal branch, yet the bus shows T-0554 merged.

What:
1. Your branch starts at the goal/T-0551 head. Run `git cherry-pick 8464b1b 6ea3ee3` (both reachable from task/T-0554 in this repo). If a conflict appears, keep the goal branch's version of anything T-0558/T-0559 changed and T-0554's intent for the identifiers; do not change behaviour beyond the two commits.
2. If xcodegen is how the project file is produced here, regenerate apple/LunaInbox.xcodeproj from apple/project.yml so it matches; commit it.
3. Commit first. Then run focused checks in the foreground only: the BundleConfigurationTests and NotificationTests Apple tests, and the 17_m9_schedules.sql pgTAP file if local Supabase is up. Never run the full gate and never background a command; the daemon gates externally.
4. Final message: the JSON result with the commit shas.

Bundle id decision (human, 2026-09-29): com.deskmere.app, widgets com.deskmere.app.AppWidgets, App Group group.com.deskmere.app. The App IDs are registered on the Apple team since 2026-09-30.
acceptance: goal/T-0551 contains the changes of 8464b1b (T-0554 update Deskmere Apple identifiers) and 6ea3ee3 (T-0554 isolate schedule sweep pgTAP test from cron): git cherry-pick of both onto this task branch, which starts at the goal head

apple/project.yml APP_BUNDLE_ID default is com.deskmere.app; widget com.deskmere.app.AppWidgets; App Group group.com.deskmere.app in project.yml, entitlements and code; the lunainbox:// URL scheme is unchanged
apple/LunaInboxTests/BundleConfigurationTests.swift exists and passes in the focused Apple test run
